name: Mother
source:
She is the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c10013]Natsuki[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c10020]Tsukumo[/url]. 

She left with her [url=https://vndb.org/c69868]husband[/url] to take over a family business outside the city in the present time and no longer live in the family home. They come back from time to time to visit their children.

They are much more present in the past because they work in the city and not outside (because they have not yet taken over the family business).
